sentences.text: 2. Heard Sri Sudhakara Rao Ambati, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for the respondents.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that basing on the confessional statement of co-accused, the name of the petitioner/A11 has been figured in the FIR.
Except the said confessional statement, no other material is placed on record showing the complicity of the petitioner in the present crime.
Learned counsel would further submit that the confession statement of co-accused is not admissible in evidence.
Basing on the same, the learned counsel for the petitioner prays this Court to quash the proceedings in connection with the said crime.

4. On the other hand, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondents would submit that the petitioner herein is the supplier of the contraband involved in the present crime and there are specific accusations to that extent and it is not a fit case for quashment.
5. A perusal of the entire material on record goes to show that there is specific accusation as against the petitioner herein that he is supplying the contraband to co-accused.

It is submitted by the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor that a stay has been granted in the present crime for conducting further investigation, due to which, the investigation in the present crime is still pending.
Truth or otherwise of the said accusations made against the petitioner has to be decided during the course of investigation.

When specific accusations have been made against the petitioner, it is premature for this Court to conduct a thorough enquiry into the disputed questions of fact in a petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., and quash the proceedings at this stage.
6. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is not inclined to quash the proceedings and, accordingly, the Criminal Petition is dismissed.
As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition, shall stand closed.
